line: Framework Laptop 13 (2025, AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series, DIY Edition)
config_name: Laptop 13 DIY — Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, 32GB DDR5 (2x16GB), 1TB NVMe, 2.8K 120Hz matte display

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 (12-core/24-thread Zen 5/5c, up to 5.1GHz)
specs.ports: 4x user-swappable Expansion Card slots (USB-C/USB-A/HDMI/DP/Ethernet/microSD/storage; cards sold separately), 3.5mm
specs.os: None (DIY — bring your own; Windows or Linux)

battery.notes: 61Wh. HX 370 draws more under load than AI 5; light-use still ~9h. NPU 50 TOPS (Ryzen AI).

price.notes: Configurator component sum (2026-11-24): base $2,089 (12% off) + 32GB +$750 + 1TB SN7100 +$300. Excludes expansion cards + OS (~$200 extra real-world). Tiers frequently out of stock.

reviews.quote: Skip the Intel version for better performance. Pros: fast CPU with high performance-per-watt, readily available replacement parts, versatile USB-C expansion cards, FreeSync Premium support, easily serviceable. Cons: USB-C ports are not identical in terms of features, speakers and webcam are showing their age, lid and base susceptible to flexing, no OLED/P3/HDR.

praises: HX 370 makes the FW13 a genuine multitasking/compile machine — 12 cores in a 1.3kg repairable chassis is unique
Radeon 890M handles light 1080p gaming and video editing better than any Lunar Lake iGPU
50 TOPS NPU with official Linux + Windows support for local AI experimentation
Socketed RAM to 96GB — no other 13-inch ultrabook offers this
Matte 3:2 2.8K 120Hz panel is tall and sharp; kill-switch webcam praised for privacy
complaints: At ~$3,100 CAD before cards and OS, it costs as much as a MacBook Pro with worse speakers and webcam
Fan audible under sustained all-core loads; thin chassis throttles the HX 370 short of its siblings
Speakers remain weak — the one part Framework hasn't upgraded
High-tier DIY boards are the first to sell out in each batch

design_philosophy: The top DIY tier proves Framework's thesis at the performance end: a repairable, upgradeable thin-and-light that competes on CPU with mainstream premium ultrabooks while everything inside remains owner-serviceable. Buyers pay for the modular platform, not just silicon.
standouts: 12-core HX 370 + 50 TOPS NPU in a 1.3kg fully repairable chassis — no equivalent exists
Mainboard upgrade path keeps the chassis alive across future CPU generations
dealbreakers: Weak speakers and dated 1080p webcam at ~$3,100 CAD before cards and OS
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the Framework Laptop 13.5 Ryzen AI 9 (84%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). See SHARED-framework.md. avg_score 8.4 from NBC gap-fill review.
